per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to user actions within 5 seconds to avoid user distraction or abandonment.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have a consistent look and feel across all screens, aligning with corporate design standards.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All screens created as part of the Disputes application must comply with corporate standards for interface creation.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should use color coding to visually distinguish between different case statuses (e.g., urgent, pending, closed).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be reliable and provide clear error messages when backend systems are unavailable or fail to respond.
The system should enforce access controls to ensure that users can only view and manage disputes for cardmembers they are authorized to handle.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available 24/7, with planned maintenance windows scheduled during low-traffic periods.
